description: Update a saved template's DSL, name, description, and/or sampleData. Revalidates the DSL when provided. A DSL that differs from the stored one is recorded in the template's revision history (History tab on /templates/:id); sending the same DSL again records nothing, and name, description and sampleData are overwritten without history. For `description` and `sampleData`: pass `null` to clear; omit to leave unchanged. Returns { templateId, name, updatedAt }. Mirrors PUT /api/v1/templates/:id.

description.description: New one-sentence summary. Pass `null` to clear the stored value; omit the key entirely to leave it unchanged.

dsl.description: Replacement builder DSL script; it is validated before saving. Omit to keep the current DSL. Up to 512KB.

name.description: New display name. Omit to keep the current name.

sampleData.description: Replacement sample binding data, stored alongside the template and returned by get_template (the web editor loads it into its Render data panel). It does not change what render_template uses without `data`: that is the DSL's own `const sampleData`. `null` clears the stored value; omit to leave it unchanged.

templateId.description: Template ID — slug for library rows (e.g. 'invoice-classic') or UUID for user rows.

name: update_template

name.description: The display name after the update.

templateId.description: Template ID: a slug for library templates, a UUID for your own.

updatedAt.description: When the template was changed, as a UTC 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' timestamp.

title: Update template
